title: cephalaria leucantha var. mediterranea
intro: Cephalaria leucantha var. mediterranea, commonly known as White Hemp Tree or Balkan Hemp Tree, is a flowering plant native to the Balkan Peninsula. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and relieving pain, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions like analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Cephalaria leucantha var. mediterranea include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. While more research is needed to confirm its efficacy, Cephalaria leucantha var. mediterranea is considered a promising natural source for the development of new medicinal products.
